newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: INSTANT VIEW - Telecel profit up 199 pct.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Telecel profit up 199 pct.

text.p: The following are reactions to the 1996 profit figure of mobile telephone operator Telecel-Comunicacoes Pessoais SA which rose 199 percent to 7.3 billion escudos.

"I think that the share price should go back to 12,500 escudos or even below after the posting of the results. The latest expectations were for between eight and nine billion escudos. The strong growth in provisions against non-payment, which were not fully claimed against tax, were the main reasons for the net profit being below the latest forecasts."
(Telecel closed at 13,001 escudos on Monday before the Carnaval holiday).

"Our forecasts were for a net profit of 7.2 billion escudos...but as the share price rose a lot in recent sessions, owing to other forecasts that were more optimistic, with people talking of profit between eight and nine billion escudos, it is would be natural for it (the price) to correct and it could go to 12,500 escudos."
